main_text.head: De vsuris.
TITVL. XV.
1. De vnciario fœnore.
main_text.p: e i.nancitur: nancitur pro nanciscitur, vt apiscitur pro adipiscitur.f hoc innuit, vt quod ante bellum contraxerit Latinus cum Romano, siue mutuû sit, siue pignus, vti id valeat.g Liuius 7. hanc institutionem refert ad M. Duellium C. Marcio (inquit)SAnè vetus vsus fœnebre malum, & sedi-tionum difcordiarumque [?]frequentissima [?]caufa, eâque cohibebatur antiquis quoque & minus corruptis moribus. Nam primo xii.§ Tabulis sanctum, Ne quis vncia-

Cn. Manlio Coff. de vnciario fœnore M. Duellio Tribunoplebis rogatio perlata est, & plebs aliquanto cam cupi-ditus sciunt, accepitque. Sed verisimilius est inter legem XII. Tabula. pene antiquatam à Duellio in vsum renocatam fuisse.

page.notes: The left-margin note text runs into the foot block; the boundary between the margin note "g" and the foot text is uncertain, and the wording of the lower lines is partly unclear. "trebertima" and "eau-" in the line "difcordiarumque trebertima eau-" are not clearly legible; the reading "frequentissima caufa" is a guess and is marked [?]. The Greek of the top line ("ἐὰν δὲ ἀνῇς") and of note "d" (ἀρχαιϰὼς) is copied from a low-resolution scan and may be inexact. Mark letters in the text (b–f) are matched to the notes by letter as printed. The run "xii.§" is copied as printed. Note "*" carries no letter in the text. The lower-left "cio (inquit)" fragment of the margin note is treated as part of note g.
